findings.where: Header nav: the MantaHostels wordmark link ('MantaHostels home') and the 'Destinations' link, on desktop and inside the phone Menu
findings.fault: Neither header link takes the visitor anywhere. The wordmark's home link points back to this page. 'Destinations' points to #destinations, and this page has no destinations section, so the link goes nowhere. Every way out of the header is dead, so after reading the method the visitor has no route to the hostels it ranks.
findings.who_objects: A backpacker on a phone who opened this page to decide whether to trust the ranking, and now wants to go and compare hostels. They tap the logo or Destinations and nothing happens, so the trust this page built ends at a dead end.

findings.where: Footer links: 'Privacy', 'Terms' and 'Report content' (desktop and phone)
findings.fault: All three are underlined links that point back to this page, so they do nothing. A visitor who wants the privacy policy, the terms, or a way to report a listing or review never reaches it. The only working footer action is the email link.
findings.who_objects: A traveller or hostel owner trying to report a wrong listing or review, or to check how their data is handled. On a page whose whole job is to earn trust, a dead 'Report content' or 'Privacy' link makes the published method look like a claim with nothing behind it.

findings.fault: It is styled like every other footer link and points to the page the visitor is already on, with no sign that it is the current page. In the header, the same link drops its underline for semibold to show it is current.
findings.who_objects: A visitor tapping it expecting a new page sees nothing happen. It is minor, because the header already shows where they are.
